sources: Broad judicial interpretation of private standing under UCL/FAL framework (1970s-2004)
Proposition 64 (Nov. 2, 2004) — amended §17200 (§17204) and §17535 to add injury-in-fact + lost money/property standing requirement
wound_addressed: Unlimited private standing created shakedown suit industry; technical violation suits by parties with no actual harm; Prop 64 aimed to restore standing requirement while preserving consumer enforcement tool
key_case_in_chain: In re Tobacco II Cases, 46 Cal.4th 298 (2009) — reliance requirement for class representatives post-Prop 64
